sections.title: -adik/-edik/-odik/-ödik: "-th"
sections.content: To turn a number into "first, second, third..." Hungarian adds an ending built on -dik, chosen by vowel harmony. The first three are irregular and just need to be learned; from four onward it's a predictable pattern.

első, második, harmadik are irregular — memorize them as a set — but everything from negyedik on is just the number plus -edik/-odik/-adik by vowel harmony, exactly like every other suffix you've learned.
